items.text: Your HR Self-Service Shouldn't Live Outside Your Microsoft Cloud

You have moved your business systems to Azure. Identity is centralized in Azure Active Directory. Data lives in Dataverse. Analytics runs on Power BI. So why is your employee self-service portal still a standalone third-party app fighting the stack it is supposed to live in?
Two Identity Systems to Manage
A standalone ESS means a second login for staff and a second directory outside Azure Active Directory for IT.
Data Outside Your Azure Tenant
Employee records, leave balances, and expenses in a vendor database instead of your Dataverse and your Azure region.
Compliance You Can't Audit End-to-End
Your Azure workloads are SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GDPR-covered. Your third-party ESS isn't necessarily.
No Power Platform Reach
Standalone ESS data can't be surfaced in Power BI or automated with Power Automate without brittle connectors.
Contractors and Deskless Staff Left Out
Third-party bolt-ons were never designed for the phone-first workforce or the license-limited contractor.

items.text: What You Can Use Folio3 ESS For

The app is organized around the four everyday workflows that generate the most HR support tickets in a Microsoft-cloud environment. Each has scoped access, its own screens, and a distinct adoption curve.
What Employees Do in the App

Maintain profiles, file time-off requests, upload expense receipts, work through onboarding steps, sign up for learning programs, check rewards balances, record working hours, and submit health declarations.
What Managers Do in the App
Clear pending approvals from one prioritized inbox, open a direct report's record without switching apps, see team absence calendars, and hand off approval authority when going on leave.
What Department Coordinators Do in the App
Apply bulk changes across a department, handle one-off policy exceptions, run cross-team reports, and get elevated visibility without needing a full Dynamics 365 HR seat.
What Contractors Do in the App

Log hours against active assignments, enter and track project-related expenses, keep certifications current, see only relevant assignment information, and log in without a full Dynamics 365 subscription.

It carries the same role model, the same permissions, and the same Azure Active Directory sign-in your workforce uses on the desktop, into a form factor built for warehouses, construction sites, retail floors, and traveling staff.

items.text: Frequently Asked Questions
Can we deploy Folio ESS in our own Azure tenant?

Yes. Folio ESS is designed to deploy into the customer's Azure environment, using the customer's own Azure region, network policies, and compliance controls. Folio3 supports the deployment as part of the implementation project.
What Azure services does Folio ESS use?

Folio ESS relies on Azure Active Directory for identity, Dataverse for HR data, Power Platform for extensibility, and standard Azure hosting and networking services. Additional Azure services can be integrated during implementation if the customer's architecture requires it.
What compliance certifications does it inherit?

Folio ESS runs on top of Microsoft services that carry SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, and other regional certifications. The app itself does not introduce a separate compliance boundary, so the underlying Azure and Dynamics 365 posture applies.
Does Folio ESS require separate licensing beyond our Microsoft subscriptions?

The app is licensed on top of an existing Dynamics 365 Human Resources subscription. Anyone with a Dynamics 365 HR seat can use Folio ESS without buying additional Microsoft licenses. For contractors and other non-permanent workers, the app provides a scoped access model that does not consume a Dynamics 365 seat per person. Exact commercial terms are worked out during scoping.
Does it work with Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations or only the standalone HR module?

Both configurations are supported. Whether Dynamics 365 Human Resources is running as its own application or has been consolidated into a Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations environment, Folio ESS talks to the same underlying data model in either case.
How long does a typical deployment take?

Most rollouts run in the weeks range rather than months, assuming Dynamics 365 Human Resources is already in production. The main variables are the number of role experiences going live at once, the mobile distribution mechanism, and how heavily the underlying HR configuration has been customized.
Where is our employee data stored?

All employee data continues to reside in the customer's own Dynamics 365 Human Resources environment, which sits inside the customer's Azure tenant and Dataverse instance. Folio ESS does not maintain a separate copy of the data on its own infrastructure.
Can we extend or customize the app?

Customization happens through Power Platform. Folio3 can build additional fields, alternate approval flows, and even new role variants as part of the implementation, using the same Power Apps and Power Automate tooling the customer already uses elsewhere.
What happens to our existing third-party ESS portal during the transition?

Retirement of the legacy portal is part of the project scope. Folio3 covers data mapping from the outgoing system, plans the cutover window, and handles the change communications to employees so no one is caught between two portals.
